version.changelog: v1.2.1 补齐全项目文件（install.sh、CONTRIBUTING、CI、完整使用教程），修正镜头数按时长反推逻辑与安全保护退出码

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a disclosed storyboard helper, but its persistent learning files can turn project-controlled text into mandatory future instructions.

dimensions.detail: Reading the article and writing storyboard outputs fit the purpose, but loading .avs/learnings.jsonl from the current project gives repository-local data persistent influence over the agent workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill documents an external avs installer that can copy the skill into multiple agent environments, but that installer is not included in the inspected artifact and the action appears user-directed rather than automatic.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md requires the agent to read prior learning entries before work and obey every entry, while learn.py prints free-form project and global entries without validation or trust separation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes persistent project and home-directory learning records and instructs mandatory writeback after each completed video; there is a forget command, but no validation limiting lessons to safe storyboard preferences.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently targets Chinese long-article-to-short-video storyboard generation, with helper scripts for scaffolding, validation, and lessons; the scripts support rather than fully replace the agent's writing workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing in shared or cloned repositories. The main risk is that a project can include .avs/learnings.jsonl entries that the skill tells the agent to obey later. Use it only in workspaces you trust, inspect learning entries before running digest/check flows, and be cautious with promoting project lessons to global memory or using the cross-agent avs install command.
llm.findings:
[T02] unexpected: Accepted as the main concern: project-local learning entries are loaded and presented as mandatory instructions, crossing from workspace data into agent authority.
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the code alone scaffolds and checks, but an agent skill can legitimately rely on SKILL.md instructions for the actual storyboard writing; this is not evidence of deception.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Partially accepted as a quality and routing concern because the description includes an empty trigger phrase, but it is not by itself malicious behavior.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Partially accepted: cross-agent installation is broad and should be explicit, but the inspected artifact only documents a user-directed external command and does not perform installation itself.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the skill is clearly presented in Chinese for a Chinese-language storyboard workflow; this is a locale limitation, not a security issue.
[AE1] expected: Overridden after inspection: the referenced artifact files present in the workspace were inspected, and no hidden remote or unavailable payload was found.
[LP3] unexpected: Partially accepted: explicit tool-scope metadata would help because the skill uses local file reads and writes, but the observed operations are mostly disclosed in the instructions.
